brief.headline: Push for a 3–4% price cut: Triveni earns 8.5% net margin vs 4.8% peer median, and we have four credible alternates.

priceAsk.summary: Request a 3–4% price reduction on rigid plastic packaging
priceAsk.target: Benchmark HDPE resin import unit value at 87.61 ₹/kg and close the gap between their 8.5% margin and the 4.8% peer median
priceAsk.basis: They run 8.5% net margin against a 4.8% peer median — 3.7 percentage points of excess. Their pricing carries significant headroom, and HDPE resin import unit value stands at 87.61 ₹/kg per UN Comtrade. We have four qualified alternates ready to quote.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Tighten payment terms from 45 days to 30 days in exchange for volume commitment
paymentTermAsk.cashImpact: ₹2.15 L working capital freed if we move to 30 days

brief.financialLeverage: Triveni is financially sound: 8.5% net margin, 14.5% EBITDA margin, 0.00x debt-to-equity, and 75.84x interest coverage. They sit in the safe zone (Altman Z 6.18) with zero leverage risk. However, their 6.6% return on capital lags the 12.6% peer median, and we represent only 0.15% of their ₹179.69 Cr revenue. One red flag: EPF payment delays signal compliance slippage. Their strong profitability and zero debt mean they can absorb a price concession without distress, but our small footprint (₹26.17 L spend) means we need competitive tension and volume commitment to extract movement.

evidence.point: Triveni's net margin is 77% higher than the peer median
Their EBITDA margin shows comfortable operating profit
Zero financial leverage — no debt pressure
We are a negligible customer — low standalone leverage
HDPE resin import benchmark provides transparent pricing floor
Compliance risk: EPF payment delays flagged

alternates.name: Manjushree Technopack Ltd
alternates.why: India's largest rigid-plastic packaging converter at ₹2569.83 Cr revenue, health score B (65/100), direct pharma bottles and caps capability — the strongest second-source candidate

alternates.name: Mold-Tek Packaging Ltd
alternates.why: Listed leader in rigid packaging (pails, containers, pharma) with ₹946.50 Cr revenue and B (73/100) health — robust alternate for bottles and closures

alternates.name: Hitech Corporation Ltd
alternates.why: Listed player with ₹701.17 Cr revenue and C (51/100) health, broad moulded and blow-moulded packaging capability across bottles and caps

risks: At 0.15% of their revenue (₹26.17 L vs ₹179.69 Cr), we lack standalone leverage — bundle SKUs, commit volume, or run a live alternate bid to create urgency
EPF payment delays are a compliance red flag; verify labour and statutory payment discipline before expanding volume
Their ₹-6.59 Cr negative free cash flow and 102d receivable days (vs 93d peer median) suggest working-capital strain despite zero debt — watch for supply continuity if we tighten terms aggressively
Triveni's 6.6% return on capital trails the 12.6% peer median, signaling capital inefficiency — they may resist price cuts to protect ROI, so frame the ask around volume growth and faster payment
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We value the partnership, but your 8.5% net margin against the 4.8% peer median tells us there's room to sharpen pricing — and we have four alternates ready to quote if we can't close the gap.
